name: Document intake
summary: Classify an incoming document by type and flag whether it needs action.

input.state: The document's extracted text or the caller's summary of it.

action_required.instructions: The document asks something of the owner - a payment, signature, deadline, or reply.
action_required.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

outputs.shape: 'action' for actionable documents, else the type label

uncertainty.abstain: an unreadable document answers 'other' plus action - an unreadable bill still needs a human
uncertainty.refusal: a refused document reports refused and lands in the manual pile

limits: Classifies supplied text; OCR and extraction are upstream.
'action' means a human looks, not that the system acts.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
